researched.description: AI platform that turns field crew video and voice into risk, safety, and productivity intelligence for utilities and infrastructure operators
researched.notes: Real product, but the site sells a general frontline-work platform to critical infrastructure operators - named customers are privatized UK utilities (Southern Water, SGN, Yorkshire Water) and private civil contractors (Ferrovial, Kier); government is not a named primary market, so scope is the owner's call.

researched.description: SAMS environmental compliance platform for water, wastewater, stormwater, cross-connection, and air quality reporting at municipal utilities
researched.notes: Confirmed on site: licensed SAMS compliance software, named customers are City of Phoenix, City of Seattle, LADWP, San Antonio Water System, City of Honolulu. Founding year not stated.

researched.description: Customer self-service portals, mobile apps, and smart meter analytics for electric, water, gas, and multi-service utilities
researched.notes: Confirmed on site: licensed portal/mobile/analytics product, 'Since 1999', part of the Harris Utilities portfolio; named customers are dominated by municipal and district utilities (Provo, Mesa, Alameda Municipal Power) alongside some investor-owned.

researched.description: ArcGIS geographic information system software, apps, and implementation for Canadian governments, utilities, schools, and public agencies
researched.notes: Not an independent product company - it is Esri Inc.'s exclusive Canadian distributor and its implementation, training and managed-services arm, which is the system-integrator/reseller pattern; the licensed product belongs to Esri Inc. (site returned 403, confirmed via Esri Canada store/news pages and Wikipedia).

researched.description: Case management, enrollment, and outcomes reporting software for state and local workforce development, adult education, and apprenticeship programs
researched.notes: Confirmed on site: licensed case-management platform (an Empyra.com, Inc. product); named customers are public workforce and education bodies - Employ Prince George's, Alamo Colleges, Palomar College, Jefferson County Public Schools, state workforce agencies. HQ and founding year still not published.

researched.description: Data Station unemployment insurance benefits and tax system for state workforce agencies
researched.notes: Confirmed on site: Data Station is a licensed UI benefits/tax platform and state unemployment insurance agencies are the only market named. Boise, ID address on site; founding year not disclosed.

researched.description: Video playout servers, scheduling, live streaming, captioning, and audio description for government access channels, legislatures, and school districts
researched.notes: Kept: sells its own hardware playout servers (QuickCast, QuickRoll, Mini) plus cloud software, with dedicated Government TV, PEG and Education applications and municipalities named throughout. Corrected year_founded to null - the earlier 2007 was inferred from a copyright range, not stated by the company.

researched.description: Chromebook checkout, device inventory, and student login security for K-12 districts running Google Workspace
researched.notes: Confirmed on site: licensed per-student software for device checkout and student login security, sold only to K-12 districts. Baltimore, MD address in the privacy policy; founding year not disclosed.

researched.description: Digital hall pass, tardy tracking, behavior management, and campus engagement platform for K-12 schools and districts
researched.notes: Confirmed on site: a licensed platform ('replace six vendors with one connected platform'), not curriculum or content, sold to K-12 schools and districts (2,500+ schools, 750+ districts). HQ and founding year still not published.

researched.description: Community data, mapping, and publishable content tools for economic development, planning, and communications teams in cities and counties
researched.notes: Checked the content-vendor risk: the products page sells embeddable interactive dashboard tools customers deploy on their own sites, not a data or report subscription, and the named market is government - 200+ government teams, Tulsa, San Antonio, New Jersey, British Columbia, Norfolk County.

researched.description: SNAP and EBT benefits mobile app for recipients, plus Propel for States tooling for state benefits agencies
researched.notes: The site's own framing makes the free consumer EBT app (5M+ users, monetized by advertising and a marketplace) the primary business; 'Propel for States' is a secondary line, so government is a real but not primary market - owner's call.

researched.description: Branded mobile app and analytics for housing authorities and community organizations to reach residents and connect them to benefits and services
researched.notes: Confirmed on site: a licensed mobile-first platform, with public housing authorities named as customers (Syracuse Housing Authority, Housing Authority of Baltimore City) alongside nonprofits and CBOs. HQ and founding year still not published.

researched.description: Smartphone symptom monitoring and relapse-prediction tool for psychosis, sold to mental health services and NHS trusts
researched.notes: Real licensed product but a clinician-prescribed UK digital therapeutic - University of Manchester spinout, NICE-recommended, buyers are NHS trusts (Cornwall Partnership, Devon Partnership, LiveWell Southwest); no US state or local market is named, so whether it belongs on a US SLED board is the owner's call. Site returned 403; verified via NHS Innovation Accelerator and University of Manchester pages.

researched.description: Cx360 electronic health record and case management software for behavioral health, substance use, IDD, and CCBHC providers
researched.notes: Real product company, but the site markets Cx360 to behavioral health, substance use, IDD and CCBHC provider organizations generally - it never names county or state agencies as a market segment, so the government share is incidental rather than primary.

researched.description: Ambient AI documentation, compliance, and revenue cycle software for community behavioral health and Medicaid-funded care organizations
researched.notes: Real product, but every named customer is a private or nonprofit provider organization (Wellpower, Centerstone, The Child Center of NY, Jefferson Center, GRAND Mental Health); the site names no government agency and sells to providers, not agencies.
